rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; same reply and project as the round-2 and round-3 rulings. f8949 p. 1, box G; i8949 p. 8, code B. The reply adds boxes G and J to the reported-basis boxes, but boxes G to L are refused at the transaction by sales.digital at sales.one. Triage executable-triage-v2 (reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.json; 1,638 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 476 partial records): 1,758 of 1,765 comparisons agree; the 7 value differences are all on refused returns (boxes G and J); no completed return differs. Project stands.

Ruling: representation and scope; i8949 p. 8, code B, and p. 10, code W. The reply returns 0 for the aggregate route, where the project gets 0 because an aggregate transaction carries no adjustment code (sales.bad_aggregate refuses any code but none on that route, i1040sd p. 10); and it extends the code B correction to boxes G and J, which never reach the line: every digital-asset box is refused at sales.one (sales.digital). On every transaction the tool completes, the values are the project's. Project stands.

Ruling: model error and scope; i8949 p. 10, code W, "enter the amount of the nondeductible loss as a positive number in column (g)", and p. 8, code B. Values are the project's (the code B correction on boxes A and D plus the wash-sale loss for W or BW); the boxes G and J and route conditions are the round-2 ruling's scope points. New evidence on the same reply: its wash-excess gate (h_wash_excess: code W and the wash-sale loss above correct basis less proceeds) refuses completed returns the project computes, because it measures the loss from the correct basis where column (e) on box A or D is the reported basis, and fires on a $0 wash-sale loss on a row with a gain; the project refuses only a positive wash-sale loss above the loss after any code B correction (sales.wash_bad; the sales.wash_loss question, "It cannot be more than the loss on this sale (column (e) less column (d), after any code B basis correction)"). Scratch run of triage.mjs on the round-3 reply (.transcription/sales.lines-ceb969c79173) over the project's other lines (1,578 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 476 partial records; 1,762 comparisons per line): 1,379 agree; on completed returns 42 candidate refusals, all h_wash_excess (e.g. classm.clcw26.2.deepseek s2, box A, code W, wash-sale loss $0.00, project $0.00); the rest are on refused or incomplete returns. The round-3 sales.wash_loss wording fix (the definition and "0 if no part of the loss is from a wash sale") does not cause it. Project stands.

Ruling: representation and scope; same reply and project as the earlier rulings. i8949 p. 8, code B: "Correct the error by entering an adjustment in column (g)"; i8949 p. 10, code W. Values: reported less correct basis for code B or BW on boxes A and D, plus the wash-sale loss for W or BW, as the project. The reply adds boxes G and J (refused with every digital-asset box by sales.digital at sales.one) and a sales.route detail condition: a Schedule D aggregate transaction with any code is refused by sales.bad_aggregate, so the condition changes no supported return. This round changed only the wording of sales.wash_loss (stock received as pay), not an expression. Project stands.

Ruling: representation and scope; i8949 p. 8, code B, and p. 10, code W. Values: reported less correct basis for code B or BW on boxes A and D, plus the wash-sale loss for W or BW, as the project. The reply adds boxes G and J (refused by sales.digital) and declares its own gates (h_aggregate_bad, h_other_code, special), which the project has as sales.bad_aggregate, sales.bad_code and sales.special. Triage executable-triage-v2 (reviews/2025/transcription/triage/sales.json; 1,638 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 476 partial records): 1,627 of 1,765 comparisons agree; 16 candidate-refuses, 119 candidate-unknown and 3 project-unknown, all on refused or incomplete returns; no completed return differs (the round-3 h_wash_excess refusals do not recur). Project stands.

Ruling: representation and scope; same reply and project as the earlier rulings. i8949 p. 8, code B: "Correct the error by entering an adjustment in column (g)"; i8949 p. 10, code W. Values: reported less correct basis for code B or BW on boxes A and D, plus the wash-sale loss for W or BW, as the project. The reply adds boxes G and J (refused with every digital-asset box by sales.digital at sales.one), a sales.route detail condition (a Schedule D aggregate transaction with any code is refused by sales.bad_aggregate, so the condition changes no supported return) and its own refusals for other codes and adjusted aggregates. executable-triage-v2 (.transcription/triage/2025/sales.json, pass 8c6004669339; 1,767 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 466 partial records): 1,698 of 1,833 agree; 9 candidate-refuses, 120 candidate-unknown, 6 project-unknown, all on refused or incomplete returns; no completed return differs. This round changed only the wording of sales.wash_loss (stock received as pay, a bonus award), not an expression. Project stands.

Ruling: representation and scope; i8949 p. 8, code B: "Correct the error by entering an adjustment in column (g)"; i8949 p. 10, code W. Values: reported less correct basis for code B or BW on boxes A and D, plus the wash-sale loss for W or BW, as the project. The reply adds boxes G and J (refused by sales.digital) and a sales.route detail condition: a Schedule D aggregate transaction with any code is refused by sales.bad_aggregate (route aggregate and code not none), so the condition changes no supported return. Project stands.

Ruling: model error and scope; i8949 p. 8, code B, and p. 10, code W, "enter the amount of the nondeductible loss as a positive number in column (g)". Values on the supported case are the project's (reported less correct basis for code B or BW on boxes A and D, plus the wash-sale loss for W or BW); boxes G and J are refused with every digital-asset box (sales.digital) and codes other than B and W at sales.bad_code, as the earlier rulings. The reply's own consistency gate (sales.h_wash_exceeds) refuses completed returns the project computes, where the wash-sale loss is no more than the loss on the sale: sales.adjust.A.W, sales.adjust.D.W, sales.adjust.A.W.equal_loss (project column (g) $500.00, $500.00, $200.00); the project refuses only a wash-sale loss above the loss after any code B correction (sales.wash_bad, and the sales.wash_loss question, "The loss entered cannot be more than the loss on this sale"). The reworded sales.code (BUG-0476, codes D and O) changes no value. executable-triage-v2 (`.transcription/triage/2025/sales.json`, pass 482b0f4853ea): 1,745 of 1,822 agree; 61 candidate-unknown, 7 candidate-refuses (3 on completed returns, above), 9 project-unknown. Project stands.

Ruling: representation and model error; i8949 p. 11, column (h). The value is the project's ((d) less (e) plus (g)); the reply shows the line only on the detail route, but the transaction's column (h) amount is read on both routes (sd.line1a.h and sd.line8a.h for the aggregate route), and the project's sheet is a values sheet, so the display condition changes no value. Its candidate refusals are column (g)'s h_wash_excess gate (see (g)). Scratch run of triage.mjs on the round-3 reply (.transcription/sales.lines-ceb969c79173) over the project's other lines (1,578 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 476 partial records; 1,762 comparisons per line): 1,380 agree; on completed returns 42 candidate refusals, the column (g) records; 4 value differences, all on refused returns. Project stands.
